title: T13 — Statement of Architecture Work (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Statement of Architecture Work — T13 Tool platform

## Assignment

The T13 slice (issue #76) under the programme's architecture governance; the live contract is
`01a20271-2a37-7329-b159-28031ddcb966`.

## Scope

The broker `tools.call` and its seven steps; the four catalogue/ledger tables; effect-class gating;
the closed-schema input check; credential aliases over sealed secrets; the direct MinIO storage
adapter with the mandatory tenant prefix; the coding toolkit and one kag-era toolkit; V1
external-action migration; six gate proofs.

## Responsibilities

The delivery team implements and proves the six clauses; the PM job routes the gates; the
Architecture Board approves the contract and the A–D artefacts; the programme board reviews the
tranche.

## Acceptance criteria

The six §12 clauses and their named tests, as written in `acceptance/programme/T13.toml`; the
manifest is the gate, not this document.

## Contract

The live `statement_of_architecture_work` contract `01a20271-2a37-7329-b159-28031ddcb966`, approved;
its body names the same scope, approach, deliverables and risks.
